dataset_name: India Travel Knowledge Base - Fully Populated RAG Seed
purpose: Production-oriented stable knowledge seed for a LangChain travel recommender/chatbot.
important_data_policy: Stable destination identity and tourism context are stored locally.
Ratings, reviews, photos, prices, opening hours, weather and current availability must be fetched dynamically.
No current ratings, review counts, prices, coordinates or opening hours are fabricated.
AI-enriched fields are explicitly labeled and should be verified before being treated as authoritative.
Official Ministry of Tourism sources are preferred for stable tourism facts.

source_catalog.name: Google Places API
source_catalog.role: runtime place details, reviews, photos, hours and location data
